newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Oct-Dec output seen up 2.9% qtr/qtr - MITI.
newsitem.headline: Japan Oct-Dec output seen up 2.9% qtr/qtr - MITI.

text.p: Japan's industrial output in the October-December period is expected to rise 2.9 percent from the previous quarter, after a revised quarter-on-quarter rise of 1.6 percent in July-September, a senior official at the Ministry of International Trade and Industry said on Friday.
Production for the October-December quarter is likely to show a year-on-year rise of 4.6 percent compared with a 3.9 percent year-on-year increase in the July-September period, the official added.
The official said the revision of the September data did not mean that the ministry had changed its view that industrial production was on a "gradual upward trend".
MITI said earlier that Japan's industrial production in September increased a revised 1.5 percent from the previous month compared with a preliminary estimate of a 1.0 percent increase.
